confirm.title: EnergyCalc: {name}
confirm.description:
Create energy (kWh) sensors for the power sensors on **{name}**?

The new sensors are shown on the existing device page and can be used on the Energy Dashboard.

user.title: Add an energy sensor
user.description: Pick a power sensor (W) and EnergyCalc will create an energy sensor (kWh) that integrates it over time. The new sensor is shown on the power sensor's device and can be used on the Energy Dashboard.

data_description.power_entity_id: The power sensor to integrate. It must report watts.
data_description.integration_method: The Riemann sum method used to approximate the integral.
data_description.unit_prefix: The unit of the energy sensor.
data_description.round_digits: Number of decimal places to round the result to.
data_description.max_sub_interval_minutes: How long to wait for a source update before integrating the last known value again.

abort.already_configured: Energy sensors are already configured for this power sensor
abort.not_supported: EnergyCalc cannot be added manually. Add 'energycalc:' to your configuration.yaml to enable automatic discovery, or call the energycalc.create_energy_sensor action.

error.not_a_power_sensor: That entity does not report power in watts.
error.already_tracked: EnergyCalc already tracks that power sensor.

create_energy_sensor.name: Create energy sensor
create_energy_sensor.description: Creates an energy (kWh) sensor that integrates a power (W) sensor over time.

integration_method.name: Integration method
integration_method.description: The Riemann sum method used to approximate the integral.

round_digits.name: Precision
round_digits.description: Number of decimal places to round the result to.

unit_prefix.name: Metric prefix
unit_prefix.description: Metric prefix for the sensor unit. 'k' produces kWh, none produces Wh.

max_sub_interval_minutes.name: Max sub-interval
max_sub_interval_minutes.description: How long the integration waits for a source update before integrating the last known value again.

remove_energy_sensor.name: Remove energy sensor
remove_energy_sensor.description: Removes an energy sensor created by EnergyCalc.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The EnergyCalc energy sensor to remove.
